traditions.LXX: Ἔλθετε εἰς Ἑσεβών , ἵνα οἰκοδομηθῇ καὶ κατασκευασθῇ πόλις Σηών .
traditions.VUL: Veníte in Hésebon : ædificétur , et construátur cívitas Sehon :
traditions.SP: באי חשׁבון תבנה ו תתכונן עיר סיחון
traditions.KJV: Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :

28.english_reference: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon :

traditions.WLC: כִּי אֵשׁ֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה מֵֽ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן לֶהָבָ֖ה מִ קִּרְיַ֣ת סִיחֹ֑ן
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πῦρ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ Ἑσεβών , φλὸξ ἐκ πόλεως Σηών ·
traditions.VUL: ignis egréssus est de Hésebon , flamma de óppido Sehon ,
traditions.SP: כי אשׁ יצאה מ חשׁבון להבה מ קרית סיחון
traditions.KJV: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon :

28.english_reference: it hath consumed Ar of Moab , [ and ] the lords of the high places of Arnon .

traditions.WLC: אָֽכְלָה֙ עָ֣ר מוֹאָ֔ב בַּעֲלֵ֖י בָּמ֥וֹת אַרְנֹֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέφαγεν ἕως Μωάβ , καὶ κατέπιεν στήλας Ἀρνών .
traditions.VUL: et devorávit Ar Moabitárum , et habitatóres excelsórum Arnon .
traditions.SP: אכלה עד מואב בעלי במות ארנן
traditions.KJV: it hath consumed Ar of Moab , [ and ] the lords of the high places of Arnon .

29.english_reference: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh :

traditions.WLC: אוֹי לְ ךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖דְתָּ עַם כְּמ֑וֹשׁ
traditions.LXX: Οὐαί σοι , Μωάβ · ἀπώλου , λαὸς Χαμώς .
traditions.VUL: Væ tibi Moab : perísti pópule Chamos .
traditions.SP: אוי לך מואב אבדת עם כמושׁ
traditions.KJV: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh :

29.english_reference: he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .

traditions.WLC: נָתַ֨ן בָּנָ֤י ו פְּלֵיטִם֙ וּ בְנֹתָ֣י ו בַּ שְּׁבִ֔ית לְ מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱמֹרִ֖י סִיחֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: ἀπεδόθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν διασώζεσθαι , καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν αἰχμάλωτοι , τῷ βασιλεῖ τῶν Ἀμορραίων Σηών .
traditions.VUL: Dedit fílios eius in fugam , et fílias in captivitátem regi Amorrhæórum Sehon .
traditions.SP: נתן בניו פלטים ו בנתיו ב שׁבי ל מלך ה אמרי סיחון
traditions.KJV: he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .

30.english_reference: We have shot at them ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon ,

traditions.SP: ו נירם אבדה חשׁבון עד דיבון
traditions.KJV: We have shot at them ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon ,

30.english_reference: and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which [ reacheth ] unto Medeba .

traditions.WLC: וַ נַּשִּׁ֣ים עַד נֹ֔פַח אֲשֶׁ֖רׄ עַד מֵֽידְבָֽא

traditions.KJV: and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which [ reacheth ] unto Medeba .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ הָ אֱמֹרִֽי

traditions.SP: ו ישׁב ישׂראל ב ערי ה אמרי
traditions.KJV: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν Ἰαζήρ ,

traditions.SP: ו ישׁלח משׁה ל רגל את יעזיר
traditions.KJV: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer ,

32.english_reference: and they took the villages thereof ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּלְכְּד֖וּ בְּנֹתֶ֑י הָ

traditions.VUL: cuius cepérunt vículos ,
traditions.SP: ו ילכדו בנתיה
traditions.KJV: and they took the villages thereof ,

traditions.SP: ו יורישׁו את ה אמרי אשׁר שׁם
traditions.KJV: and drove out the Amorites that [ were ] there .

33.english_reference: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְנוּ֙ וַֽ יַּעֲל֔וּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַ בָּשָׁ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστρέψαντες ἀνέβησαν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Βασάν ·

traditions.SP: ו יפנו ו יעלו דרך ה בשׁן
traditions.KJV: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan :

33.english_reference: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ הַ בָּשָׁ֨ן לִ קְרָאתָ֜ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ὢγ βασιλεὺς τῆς Βασὰν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς ,

traditions.SP: ו יצא עוג מלך ה בשׁן ל קראתם
traditions.KJV: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them ,

33.english_reference: he , and all his people , to the battle at Edrei .

traditions.WLC: ה֧וּא וְ כָל עַמּ֛ וֹ לַ מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי

traditions.SP: הוא ו כל עמו ל מלחמה אדרעי
traditions.KJV: he , and all his people , to the battle at Edrei .

34.english_reference: And the LORD said unto Moses , Fear him not :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔ וֹ

traditions.SP: ו יאמר יהוה אל משׁה אל תירא אתו
traditions.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses , Fear him not :

34.english_reference: for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י בְ יָדְ ךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛ וֹ וְ אֶת כָּל עַמּ֖ וֹ וְ אֶת אַרְצ֑ וֹ

traditions.SP: ו עשׂית לו כ אשׁר עשׂית ל סיחון מלך ה אמרי
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Ἑσεβών .

traditions.SP: אשׁר ישׁב ב חשׁבון

35.english_reference: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive :
